msg: Gnomes are split into two groups: earthy colours (green, yellow, orange, and brown) and non-earthy colours (purple, pink, red, and blue). Each group will give seperate benefits, and this is consistent across all gnome choices (e.g. an earthy colour may give more benefits than non-earthy colour, and this will be the case across all gnomes). However, pay attention to which group of gnomes (earthy or non-earthy) gives the most benefits at any given time as this can change over time (e.g. earthy gnomes may give more benefits initally, but partway through a rounf this can change), and so be sure to experiment between both groups to see which yields the most points at any given time.
